## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` and `bun run build` pass in the script folder
- [ ] `bun run validate:prompts` passes (if prompts changed)
- [ ] Tested in a real browser with a userscript manager
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, and `version` bumped in `package.json` if this should be released
- [ ] No tracking, analytics or new network destinations (or they are explained above)
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to the contribution terms in it
